notes.title: News about the next update!
notes.content:
So, I have some cool news about the next update! Age of Iron, part 2!

I have finished putting together the Online mode! Well, one part of it. 

So, the new online mode! Time to start talking about it!

So, when this update arrives, there will be 3 ships that you can play to unlock and use. The gameplay is you select a ship, then go look for a lobby to join or host. Once it starts, the host selects a PVE mission to play. The current ships are the following

Sloop
Ketch
Bridg

More ships will be added over time, including Iron clads. 

How to play - W to speed up, S to slow down, A and D to turn right / left. Pressing " 1 " Will fire the left boradside, pressing " 2 " will fire the right boradside. You can also rotate the camera my clicking and holding, or by using the arrow keys!

There will be 3 missions. Operation Destruction - fight your way though a hostile blocade, and destroy the shipyard!


Operation Survival - Fight wave after wave, until victory!

Operation Escape - hostile reinforcements are here! You must escape the area to win!


Below are some screen shots of the online PVE mode!

Once I add in the rest of the Iron ships are added for Age of Iron, this update will go live!

What comes after though? A update fully for the PVE mode! That update will add 6 new PVE maps, and all Age of Sail ships playable and fightable! 


Until then! o7.

notes.title: Age of sail update info!
notes.content:
Age of Sail update is half way done! Progress for it is going swimmingly! In total, you will have 9 new ships to play with! All from the Age of Sail! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42951235/30e098110c63a85eee98ea0f2e983c900a07585c.png[/img]

Theses are the ships that are finished for the update, oh, and there is new water! 

Along with 9 Age of Sail ships, you will have the first 3 missions of the game! Along with 4 new maps to use in freeplay! 

There will also be new terrain, islands, icebergs, and islands with snow! Along with a new soundtrack as well, and a UI just for the Age of Sail ships!

A armor system is now in the game as well. If a ship is armored, cannon balls will bounce off the hull, if they are not armored, cannon balls will damage the ship as normal.

I can't wait until the update is done, and allow you all to try it out! o7.

[b]Note, models are not final, depending on how the game does will allow me to upgrade the models to be better due to my lack of modeling skills, but for now, I must make the ships as best as I can![/b]
